tool_suggestions.title: Subscription and Revenue Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a comprehensive dashboard to visualize subscription tiers, revenue trends, and active plan metrics for company management.
features: Visualize active vs. canceled subscriptions over time
Display total revenue and average revenue per user (ARPU)
Filter data by subscription tier and user demographics
Export detailed reports in CSV format

tool_suggestions.title: Headshot Generation Performance Monitor
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a performance monitoring tool to track and analyze the efficiency of AI headshot processing sessions in real-time.
features: Track average and total processing times by session
Visualize weekly and monthly trends in AI generation rates
Identify sessions with extended processing times for optimization
Alert system for managing delayed sessions

tool_suggestions.title: User Retention and Engagement Tracker
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design a tool to monitor user engagement and retention rates, drilling down into sessions, login frequency, and usage patterns.
features: Plot user login frequency and returning user rates
Compare subscription renewal rates across tiers
Analyze photo session usage and headshot downloads
Generate insights on user preferences from activity data
